metadata.source: JPL Solar System Dynamics, 'Approximate Positions of the Planets', Table 1 (Standish), EM barycentre mean elements valid 1800-2050
metadata.description: Two-body test. Inclination to the J2000 ecliptic rounded to 0 (table value -1.5e-5 deg); argument of periapsis = longitude of perihelion with node 0; mean anomaly = mean longitude - longitude of perihelion. Mass is Earth + Moon, GM ratio 1 / 328900.56.
